errors.trigger: A scalar flag is repeated or command options conflict.
errors.remediation: Provide each scalar flag at most once and use --help by itself.

errors.trigger: Provider mutation did not reach its postcondition.

errors.remediation: Preserve the original command, exit status, stdout and stderr; the cause of this internal failure is not established. Report it to guru-complete-task-closure maintenance, then use this owner's original recovery after repair without repeating completed Git/GitHub mutations.
